steps.text: wthit: the config bind ships UNKNOWN, so the only opener is the client command, whose literal chain wailac > config > open builds WailaConfigScreen over the current screen

wthit: ConfigScreen.keyPressed maps hasShiftDown() && keyCode 70 to ConfigListWidget.search(), which selects the search row and calls setFocused on that row's real vanilla EditBox, so the keyboard path focuses the box without a click

wthit: type the pinyin of 常规 (config.waila.general, the first CategoryEntry); ConfigListWidget$Entry.match builds the search key from the entry titles and tests each term with StringUtils.containsIgnoreCase(searchKey, term), i.e. containsSeq with the Chinese key as the query side
